It can be seen as a reflection of the inner radiance and purity that comes from living a righteous and God-conscious life. The name also serves as a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and wisdom, as the light of knowledge is a source of guidance and illumination for the soul. Overall, the name "Rai" is a symbol of the divine light and blessings that come from Allah, and a reminder to strive for excellence and inner radiance in all aspects of life.
